Name: Eliphaz, Son of Esau
Summary: Eliphaz was the firstborn son of Esau by Adah, and the father of Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, Kenaz, and Amalek.
KeyStory: Eliphaz's sons became the dukes of Edom's firstborn line — a different Eliphaz from Job's friend centuries later.
RelatedPeople: Esau; Adah, Wife of Esau; Teman; Omar; Zepho; Gatam; Kenaz; Amalek
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name and walk very different paths; God knows each one.
